purpose: Separate observed complete-feature prediction deficits from horizon-transfer and feature-position disagreement; no new method selection.
scope: All existing 2304 Motion compact deletion rows; three seeds, three splits, two horizons, 128 matched pairs per split. Original prediction/fixed-reference results remain unchanged.
analyses: Report all original feature and position benefit components; do not substitute task readout for complete-feature acceptance.

For each split/horizon, average seeds within each pair, then measure transferred-choice minus same-horizon future-feature-oracle loss. Feature regret is nonnegative by construction; position difference need not be.

For each split/horizon/baseline (uniform/FIFO/reject-newest), report paired feature/task gain CIs, strict positive/tie/negative signs and feature-positive/task-negative joint signs. Report seed-mean and all-three-seed support counts.
Report long-gap candidate vs unchanged fixed same-capacity reference from original output; maintain comparator identity.

bootstrap.unit: 128 paired scenes within each split; seeds averaged within pair first
bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%; descriptive, no multiplicity adjustment or new pass rule

limitations: Compact pair rows average siblings and six candidate pools, so joint signs are pair-average outcomes, not individual deletion events.
Cannot reconstruct raw deletion ranks, selection agreement, a task-optimal deletion oracle, vector residual causes, or past-only learnability from compact columns.
Already revealed synthetic development data; no independent confirmation.
